data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross release of GBP 8.7 million in prior year claims reserves. This favorable development was primarily driven by a GBP 2.6 million reduction in the estimated ultimate loss for Storm Sandy (2012), a GBP 3.5 million reduction from other large and small catastrophe events from prior years, and a GBP 2.6 million favorable development on attritional gross claims and claim expenses due to reported claims activity coming in lower than expected.
